question: What division into eight octads is sought to be known fully and exhaustively?
premises: A division into eight octads is mentioned.
The speaker seeks to know it fully.
The knowing is described as exhaustive.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and exhaustively the division into eight octads.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight-octad division is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division into eight octads.
